raw_block.rationale: Create one coupled exemption-pair reader and two schema-specific terminal formatters. The shared reader identifies only directly claimable exemptions under the already-solved applicable law, while the terminal helpers prevent EC citation strings from being confused with EV citation/value records. The generalized applicable-law reading also supports the existing Federal/Wisconsin history parent instead of hard-coding Illinois.

source_provenance.quote:
735 Ill. Comp. Stat. 5/12-1001(b)
The debtor's equity interest, not to exceed $4,000 in value, in any other property;
The following property may be exempted under subsection (b)(2) of this section:

Consumer goods.
